text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Danish press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

--- Danish pork producers are to claim 80 million crowns from German chemical group Boehringer Ingelheim for selling them a vaccine which proved ineffective against respiratory disease in pigs. The disease has been reported in pigs at 40 percent of 1,000 Danish farms which used it.
--- Record high 12.2 percent unemployment in Germany is sparking concern in Denmark where economists fear it could dent the Danish economic upturn and fuel joblessness.
--- Analysts expect mortgage credit firms to come up with the best results in many years when they present their 1996 results next week.

--- Denmark's building and metal industries could face difficulty finding qualified labour, a survey shows, threatening pressure for higher wages, with the risk of higher inflation and current account deficits.
